films.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
films.plot: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

films.title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
films.plot: We’re all just floating, waiting for someone to find us.

films.title: The Influencer Project
films.plot: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

films.title: Nayyi Navelli
films.plot: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

films.title: Relatives
films.plot: After many years of actively avoiding her family, Mariia finally decides to pay them a visit, seemingly to celebrate her grandmother's jubilee. However, her intentions might not be as wholesome as it seems, as the true nature of her visit lies in the fact that the birthday girl decided to grant Mariia the ownership over her home. Mariia's uncle Grygorii learns of this and decides to engage in a turf war with his niece, hoping that this will result in the latter changing her mind. However, the young entrepeneur is a tougher nut to crack than it initially looks.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

films.title: The Crash
films.plot: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

films.title: Desire
films.plot: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

films.title: The Dance of the Kokorrdit
films.plot: A Wounaan teenager and a leader of their community venture into the Darién in search of a sacred bird. Along the way, they will face the dangers that threaten their territory and their culture.

films.title: Lesbian Lines
films.plot: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

films.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
films.plot: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

films.title: For Those Who Love, Leave, and Love Again
films.plot: Haunted by the memory of an absent, violent father, Paul moves restlessly through Berlin’s night, drifting into fleeting encounters that only deepen his loneliness.

films.title: Shadows of Beirut
films.plot: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

films.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
films.plot: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

films.title: Kiri and Lou Go Raaa!
films.plot: The movie follows Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, as he rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood — sweeping the pair into the greatest adventure in prehistory. Along the way, they discover that you can find friendship in the wildest places.

films.title: Outsiders
films.plot: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

films.title: Bermuda Riots Are Different
films.plot: An examination of a decade of race riots between 1968 and 1977, alongside a triangle of colonial influences: Bermuda, Great Britain, and the USA.

films.title: Creatures
films.plot: In Amsterdam, a queer Polish tattoo artist creates creatures that become part of other people's bodies. Through fandoms, online communities, and kindred spirits, we explore the world surrounding the artist, Pazur Mazur.

films.title: A Girl Called Alice
films.plot: In the middle of London's mobile phone theft epidemic; a young woman with the reputation of one of the most gifted phone thieves is challenged by a notorious street gang leader to see just how good she really is, but is it a wise choice?

films.title: Baa: Ek Yoddha
films.plot: The silent struggles, scarifies, and unconditional love of a father.

films.title: Take His Life
films.plot: Beneath the glitter of London's finance world, a destitute man forces his way back from the streets into power. Over the course of a week, his hunger for success hardens into obsession, exposing a ruthless truth: in a system built on glass, survival demands taking another's life.

films.title: Breezeblock
films.plot: In the heart of the forest, a man is building a concrete wall to protect himself from a fly that is swooping down towards him.

films.title: Close
films.plot: Keane, nearing thirty, finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.

films.title: For Your Suffering
films.plot: A young boy lives in the shadow of his abusive stepfather - until tonight.

films.title: Gupi and the King Who Doesn't Smile
films.plot: Gupi and her friends enter an abandoned apartment in their building to deliver a cake. By passing through a closet in one of the rooms, they find themselves in a dark, unhappy, and otherworldly dimension. This place is home to the palace of the King Who Does Not Smile, whose sorrow has spread across the entire realm. Realizing that the inhabitants of this dimension have lost their joy because the King never smiles, Gupi begins trying various methods to restore happiness to the kingdom.

films.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
films.plot: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

films.title: Our Share of Sand
films.plot: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

films.title: Premada Oorali
films.plot: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

films.title: Acharya
films.plot: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.

films.title: FLORID
films.plot: Jamal, a young man who hears voices, struggles to balance his medication with his musical ambitions and romantic desires.

films.title: Early Winter's Sorrow
films.plot: An elderly writer arrives at an abandoned village, where only derelict houses remain. He goes to the farm where he spent his childhood. After a new bridge was built, the village was plagued by robberies and threats, and his family moved to a small remote farming community. Their peaceful working environment was threatened by Russian soldiers monitoring the village by air and making harassing visits. The personal stories of the small community that we witness are adapted from the novels of Revaz Inanishvili.

films.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
films.plot: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

films.title: NAZA
films.plot: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

films.title: Blue Hour
films.plot: Joey, a student from Yorkshire, keeps his head down and works quietly, more comfortable with tools than with people. The workshop is familiar to him - noisy, practical, predictable. That changes when Skyla, an exchange student from Texas, joins the course. She's open, direct, and out of place in a way that immediately stands out.

films.title: Out of Breath
films.plot: OUT OF BREATH shines the spotlight on the human cost paid by people living with sleep apnea and their loved ones. Yet, for all the darkness they face there is also light at the end of the tunnel as their hope, courage, and perseverance brings them closer to the promise of successful treatment.

films.title: Rooted Out: Chapter One
films.plot: Set against the backdrop of the Southport Riots of 2024, a dispute between neighbouring families over a tree spirals into a volatile confrontation, exposing buried prejudice, racial tension, and moral hypocrisy.

films.title: Landing Nowhere
films.plot: Two astronauts stranded on a deserted planet must decide between completing their mission - repopulating a new world artificially. Or preserve the planet's untouched beauty & let humanity fade away...

films.title: The Meadows
films.plot: When aspiring actor Viola lands the role of Juliet in a community theatre production, she’s drawn into the orbit of her volatile co-star, whose narcissism and unhinged intensity begin to unravel both the play and her sense of self.

films.title: Dùthchas: Our Underwater Forests
films.plot: An animated documentary exploring the parallel loss of marine biodiversity and Gaelic culture and language in Scotland. Six interviews with researchers and practitioners,explore marine ecosystems, capitalism, and rewilding alongside a fully animated visual story. The hand-painted animation is based on underwater sketches, giving it a dreamlike yet accurate look.

films.title: Jet Lag: The Game – Japanorama Finale
films.plot: Watch the conclusion of Jet Lag: The Game's biggest season ever with this screening of the final two, action-packed episodes as Tom & Adam race Sam & Ben to the top of Hokkaido.

films.title: Bloodline
films.plot: An ancient curse with roots in Egypt resurfaces in a mysterious Istanbul mansion. Summoned to the estate by his dying grandfather, Can and his friends are soon forced to confront the mansion's dark secrets and a supernatural threat.

films.title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
films.plot: A violent crime committed against a much-loved local and the police investigation brings bad news for DS Marlene Pettigrew. Love is also in the air and there’s a wedding to plan, but this is Port Devine, what could possibly go wrong?

films.title: Transformation
films.plot: A feature-length documentary exploring the profound inner metamorphosis of Ukrainian civilians from the creative sector who chose to enlist as soldiers to defend their country. The film maps the deep psychological and lifestyle shifts experienced by musicians, artists, and filmmakers as they stepped away from civilian art to enter the realities of war.

films.title: Suspect: The Road Rage Killer
films.plot: Examines the case of Tracie Andrews, who claimed her fiancé had been killed in a shocking road rage attack. After a disastrous press conference, she found herself accused of murdering him. Detectives revisited timelines, cross-checked statements, and tested forensic evidence and slowly, the woman who entered the station as a witness found herself at the centre of suspicion.

films.title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
films.plot: An aging political comrade leaves his career behind for marriage, only to find himself trapped in a chaotic, comical bind between two women and the bitter grudges of opposing political families.

films.title: Enter the Television
films.plot: From Tom Seymour creator of the VHS Massacre Trilogy. Enter the Television is a feature-length documentary exploring the dark corners of television from obscure commercials to unconventional cable programming. It examines the evolution of media through an underground lens, revealing how independent voices survive within systems controlled by powerful media corporations.

films.title: Old Knobbley
films.plot: In 17th century England, two women persecuted for witchcraft find sanctuary and safety at the site of a five-hundred year old oak tree.

films.title: Tutt Paini English Ne
films.plot: Blending comedy with heartfelt family moments, this movie explores the clash between cultural pride and modern aspirations through characters every Punjabi household will recognise.

films.title: Mitrata
films.plot: Mitrata follows three inseparable friends whose bond is hilariously and heart-warmingly tested by a chaotic twist of fate. Packed with laughter, loyalty, and life-changing choices, it is the ultimate celebration of the people who know us best.

films.title: Lutt Mubarak
films.plot: After his mother is falsely accused and shamed by a corrupt jeweler, Shubh, a honest young man, fights to reclaim his family's dignity. With detective Nyamat's help, he steps into a dangerous world of greed and crime to expose the truth.

films.title: Burdens of Darkness: A Student Filmmaker's Apocalypse, The Untold Tragedy of The Making of 'Incident at Madeira Road - A Short Film'
films.plot: A documentary pieced together from behind the scenes videos and interviews to tell the story of Will Lock as he undertakes the challenge of making the next great student short film.

films.title: Blue Lagoon
films.plot: Blue Lagoon explores the links between industrial extraction, ecological care, and somatic release through the lens of a post-industrial North East England coastline.

films.title: SpiceGirl
films.plot: A struggling singer returns home, tail between her legs. But a party invite from a childhood friend puts her outward persona to the test.

films.title: One Last Night
films.plot: On the eve of leaving for college, Braden takes his younger brother into the city to escape their mother's chaos, a final night of laughter, connection, and bittersweet memories amid a fractured family.

films.title: Green Grass
films.plot: It's no secret that Declan is the university class coaster, which is why his friends refuse to partner with him on their next assignment. Out of options, Declan is forced to pair up with Claire, the new Deaf student who is everything Declan isn't; academic, driven and fiercely proud of her identity. Set against the backdrop of coastal university life on the south coast of England, Green Grass dips into the murky waters of strained friendships, sustainability, and D/deaf identity in this coming-of-age drama.

films.title: Red Ledger
films.plot: Captain Georgina Lee captures and interrogates Ellis's handler on why she was sent to disarm weapons. But a piece of Lee's history is brought up that she can't escape.

films.title: Legs!
films.plot: Two pairs of legs, Lennon and Lindsey, embrace the challenging journey to explore if their continuous encounters really are just coincidences.

films.title: Hand Me Down
films.plot: Eve is donating her childhood dollhouse away to an antique store ran by a lonely old woman Lynne. As Eve explores the stores treasures, filled with memories of their past owners, she warms to Lynnes helpfulness. Picking out a recipe book, she takes it home to discover Lynnes name written in it. As an act of kindness, she brings a birthday cake baked from the recipe book back to Lynne at the store, with a new mindset and hope to retrieve her dollhouse back. Lynne is delighted by Eves recreation of her childhood cake, taking her back down memory lane, but as Eve bargains to take her dollhouse back, a little girl in the store begs her mother to purchase it. Eve watches as her item finds its new owners, reassured she is passing down a treasure for the girl to cherish as she did.

films.title: The Country Gentlewoman
films.plot: A Georgian era inspired short film that brings you the best of festive entertaining. Join Arabella and Margaret as they navigate the complexities of tricky ex-partners, the art of hosting, and perfect wine pairings.

films.title: DEQ
films.plot: "DEQ" is a legacy in Kurdish Culture. A bridge between Human and Nature and a way to find meaning of life.

films.title: It's Pronounced Dave
films.plot: A far-right South Asian MP candidate questions his campaign when he begins thinking in his native language.

films.title: Hot Flash
films.plot: Geri, a skint Yorkshire mum in peri-menopausal chaos, goes viral after a wine-fuelled rant about her menopause app idea. Betrayed by friends and terrified of public speaking, she must conquer her fears, pitch big, and finally back herself.

films.title: The Pen That Will Not Bow
films.plot: The early life of Voltaire, before he became one of Europe's most influential writers and philosophers.

films.title: The Memory Remains
films.plot: Alex, a grieving scientist, uses an experimental machine to reconstruct his partner Laura’s mind from his own memories, but as she awakens, fragmented recollections begin to challenge his carefully constructed version of their life. As Laura pieces together her past, she discovers the disturbing truth behind Alex’s work and must confront the man whose obsession with progress has pushed their relationship- and her own identity- to the brink.

films.title: The Sound We Make Together
films.plot: Striving for fame, is that the right reason to be head over heels in the competitive music industry? It's no secret that the music industry is one of the toughest out there…creative slumps, isolation, the fear of 'not making it' and failure. So, we introduce The Hills Brothers, a brotherly duo of musicians, local to Portsmouth, who spend their nights hosting several Open Mic nights all over Portsmouth and Hampshire. Take a deeper look into why they find these Open Mic nights more than just a fun night to express yourself and your music. Understand why these nights create a community for musicians and why venues like Casemates are essential for the artists support.

films.title: Bridport Torchlight Procession
films.plot: Bridport Torchlight Procession in Dorset has been shrouded in tradition, with locals believing it has little history. Step into a journey through time, uncovering its origins as a celebration event, marking elections and how it has evolved over the decades and become a cornerstone of local culture.

films.title: Dreamscape
films.plot: Dreamscape is a quest on the weight of times we never imagined would become our reality. In the quiet hours of sleep, when our defenses soften, buried emotions rise to the surface, often more vivid than waking life. For those shaped by migration and marked by generational trauma, dreams become both a refuge and a mirror. This film explores how the unconscious mind reflects collective and personal struggle. It journeys through the inner worlds we create to survive, to heal, and to simply endure whether that's building coping mechanisms through faith, art, somatics or activism.

films.title: Mucker
films.plot: Mucker provides a fascinating insight into the professional and personal life of the pioneering and award winning British documentary film maker Brian Moser.

films.title: Ukraine Ghost Ship
films.plot: When Russian forces bombed a giant hydroelectric dam on Ukraine’s mighty Dnipro River in June 2023, farmland flooded, homes were destroyed and over 50 people lost their lives. Upriver, as waters drained, ancient ships’ timbers were uncovered on the newly exposed beach. Now, a Ukrainian archaeologist Dmitro Kobaliaa has assembled an international team to recover these remains, to reveal the story of a vast Russian military flotilla sent to conquer land around the Black Sea coast. It’s a battle still raging today. As fighter jets shoot overhead, Dmitro’s discoveries reveal a history of Ukraine before Russian rule, a history the Russians are trying to destroy, but one Dmitro is desperate to preserve.

films.title: Agbara Nla: The Return
films.plot: When a feared village doctor rises with dark spiritual power to terrorize the land, a young courageous couple, Olatomi and Olaboye, must embrace their divine calling to confront evil, ignite revival, and prove that no power is greater than the name of Jesus.

films.title: Run
films.plot: London has fallen. Food is scarce, hope is fading, and the undead roam the streets. When two survivors embark on a dangerous supply run, an encounter with the infected forces them apart. Alone in a city overrun by the dead, each must fight to survive and find their way back to the other.

films.title: Of Times There Were Before
films.plot: Of Times There Were Before is a portrait of Romila Thapar, one of the world’s most influential historians and public intellectuals. At ninety-four, having lived through much of the making of modern India, she stands at an unusual distance from the past she has spent a lifetime studying. The film began with a simple question: who is the person behind the historian’s name? Shot at her home in New Delhi, it is an attempt to encounter Thapar beyond the authority of her work and the public image built around it. What emerges is a portrait of a life still in conversation with its own time.

films.title: ELECTRICKS
films.plot: An electrician takes a job to replace sockets, desperate for cash after months of unpaid invoices. In a young mother’s flat, he discovers an illegal electricity bypass left behind by her parents. For her, it means a debt of hundreds of thousands; for him, the impossibility of finishing his work. Should he walk away and look for money elsewhere, or help her through unofficial means? A drama about survival in a system that leaves both characters with no choice but to bend its rules.

films.title: Procedure
films.plot: In 1976, Elaine Carter, a closeted police officer, is assigned to escort Thomas Avery, a whistleblower whose actions saved the life of the woman she loves. Confined together mid-flight, Elaine is forced to confront the strict procedure that has defined her career, and the personal cost of finally breaking it.

films.title: Behind the Reflection
films.plot: A woman struggles with their identity, leading to a life of addiction, alcoholism and violence. A gritty drama based on the true life of Rozelle Gemma.

films.title: The First Silence
films.plot: A gaslit woman battles with her memory of events.

films.title: Gaffer
films.plot: As the manager of an unruly Sunday League team, the Gaffer lives for the 90 minutes every week where he’s in total control. But when his best player goes missing just minutes before the most important game of the season, the Gaffer’s fragile authority begins to crumble.

films.title: Perfect Imperfection
films.plot: A conversation between a uni-bound student and his mentor. Exploring themes of voice and vulnerability.

films.title: Hazard Perception
films.plot: An expectant father and a woman haunted by her fear of driving spark an unexpected connection while waiting to be called in for their driving test.

films.title: Close
films.plot: Keane finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.

films.title: Egg
films.plot: Struggling after his father's death, Josh goes to visit his father's oldest friend Ray, who lives off-grid in remote Wales. Surrounded by wild birds, Josh finds an abandoned egg and is compelled to find its nest to return it and takes Ray along with him. While talking, the two men find a way of sharing their grief and looking forward.

films.title: Her Daughters’ Mother
films.plot: After getting married at the age of 16, Ejiro is thrown into a world she is unprepared for, seeking freedom and agency in hopeless places.

films.title: The Dog Whistle
films.plot: An obnoxious conservative politician is repeatedly pestered over the phone for an unknown reason

films.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
films.plot: Aberfan's grieving community takes on the government, demanding justice and removal of the remaining tips after the disaster that killed 144 people

films.title: Unseen: The Aberfan Portraits
films.plot: Following the Aberfan disaster in 1966, an artist from Llandudno embarked on an extraordinary mission to paint portraits of most of the 116 children who lost their lives, using photographs and locks of hair provided by their grieving families.  For the first time, relatives share what these remarkable paintings have meant to them over the past six decades. Presented by the BBC’s Huw Thomas, he discovers how the portraits became enduring symbols of remembrance in a village touched by tragedy.

films.title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
films.plot: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

films.title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
films.plot: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

films.title: Homecoming Shenanigans
films.plot: Ivan returns home after six years abroad in Barcelona, hoping for a joyful reunion with his vibrant family. However, what begins as a celebratory welcome quickly spirals into chaos as deep-seated secrets surface.

films.title: Alex Jones: One Day in Aberfan
films.plot: Alex Jones marks the 60th anniversary of the mining disaster that claimed 144 lives, including 116 children
films.original_title: Alex Jones: Un Diwrnod Yn Aberfan

films.title: S K 8
films.plot: Four Skaters Skate

films.title: Thick Skin
films.plot: A group of wannabe influencers discovers that one of their "friends" has an unusual talent

films.title: Lost City
films.plot: A boxer's life improves when he begins dating a woman, but her violent ex-boyfriend, a Limerick gangster, tracks her to Belfast and pulls the boxer into a perilous criminal world.

films.title: Test 1
films.plot: Experimental film by Musa.

films.title: City of Masks
films.plot: Ambition, obsession, and lost love collide in a haunted West End theatre where a disfigured composer, a rising star, and a jealous rival fight for control of a mysterious musical-and the masked legacy that threatens to destroy them all.

films.title: Language of the Wind
films.plot: The story follows 16-year-old Shatu, who has spent her life tending cattle but secretly longs for city life. The day after her wedding to her traditional cousin Ardo (17), she finds a potential path to escape. As they lead their cattle to graze, the silence and tension between them build into a heavy confrontation of unspoken truths and life-altering decisions on the plains.
